name: Wayne Towne Center
summary: Wayne Towne Center is a community-focused power center on Route 23 featuring major retailers including Costco, Nordstrom Rack, DSW, Ulta Beauty, and JC Penney, plus 24 Hour Fitness. This convenient shopping destination serves Wayne and surrounding Passaic County communities with practical, value-oriented retail and essential services.
demographics: Wayne Towne Center attracts a diverse suburban demographic from Wayne and surrounding Passaic County communities, primarily serving middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The trade area draws heavily from established residential neighborhoods with a mix of young professionals, growing families, and empty nesters who value convenient access to big-box retailers and essential services. Shoppers typically visit for practical, mission-driven trips focused on groceries, home goods, fitness, and everyday necessities rather than leisure browsing, with strong weekday evening and weekend traffic patterns reflecting the working professional demographic of northern New Jersey suburbs.
description: Wayne Towne Center serves as a vital community shopping destination in northern New Jersey, strategically located along Route 23 in Wayne, Passaic County. This open-air power center has established itself as a go-to location for practical, everyday shopping needs, anchored by major big-box retailers including Costco Wholesale, Nordstrom Rack, DSW Designer Shoe Warehouse, Ulta Beauty, and JC Penney. The center's tenant mix reflects a focus on value-oriented shopping and essential services, complemented by 24 Hour Fitness which adds a health and wellness component to the property. With convenient highway access and ample parking, Wayne Towne Center has become a reliable shopping hub for busy suburban families seeking efficiency and variety in one location. The center's strong performance is evidenced by its impressive 4.4-star rating across nearly 5,000 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and community loyalty in the competitive northern New Jersey retail market.
